panel.title: Available disk space on the monitored filesystem

search.query: index=personal_ops sourcetype=personal:capacity | spath | eval available_gib=round(available_bytes/1073741824,2) | timechart span=1m min(available_gib) by host

| makeresults | eval host="personal-uf", expected=1 | append [search index=personal_ops sourcetype=personal:capacity _index_earliest=-15m earliest=-24h latest=+1d | sort 0 - _indextime - _time | dedup host | eval last_indexed=_indextime, lag=_indextime-_time | fields host last_indexed lag] | stats max(expected) AS expected max(last_indexed) AS last_indexed max(lag) AS lag by host | where expected=1 | eval age_seconds=round(now()-last_indexed), status=case(isnull(last_indexed),"No sample indexed in 15 min",age_seconds>180,"Late",lag<-60,"Clock ahead",lag>180,"Arriving late",true(),"Reporting") | table host status age_seconds lag

panel.title: Ingestion delay in seconds (source clock must be accurate)

search.query: index=personal_ops sourcetype=personal:capacity | eval delay_seconds=_indextime-_time | timechart span=5m perc95(delay_seconds) by host
